title: Account Signal — consulting opener
description: Elevated pragmatic opener: the why behind at-risk accounts — receipt, next move, pattern. Not a survey product video.

beats.voiceover: Most teams don't lack data on at-risk accounts.
beats.caption: Most teams don't lack data on at-risk accounts.

beats.voiceover: They lack the why — in the customer's own words — in time to do something.
beats.caption: You don’t have the why — in the customer’s words — in time.

beats.voiceover: So we send another survey. We update the CRM note. We wait for the QBR.
beats.onScreen: Another survey. Another CRM note. Another QBR.
beats.caption: Another survey. Another CRM note. Another QBR.

beats.voiceover: All tidy. Still too late. The scoreboard said fine. The account was already gone.
beats.caption: Tidy. Still too late. The scoreboard said fine.

beats.voiceover: We start where the words already are — survey follow-ups, call transcripts, email threads.
beats.caption: Start where the words already are.

beats.voiceover: Then we turn them into a reason you can defend, a receipt you can click, and a next move.
beats.caption: A reason you can defend. A receipt. A next move.

beats.voiceover: A number that looks fine. Seven out of ten.
beats.caption: A number that looks fine. 7/10.

beats.voiceover: The follow-up finds what fine actually meant.
beats.caption: What does “fine” actually mean?

beats.voiceover: The receipt — exact quote, who said it, when, tagged.
beats.caption: Quote · who · when · CFO froze spend.

beats.voiceover: It doesn't just flag the risk. It tells you the move.
beats.caption: Loop in the exec sponsor before renewal.

beats.voiceover: That pattern hits thirteen other accounts. A driver — not an anecdote.
beats.caption: One line → matched across 13 accounts.

beats.voiceover: The receipt. The move. The pattern. That's Account Signal.
beats.caption: The receipt. The move. The pattern.

beats.voiceover: Pick two accounts you have some suspicions about. Thirty minutes.
beats.caption: Pick 2 accounts you have suspicions about.

beats.voiceover: We'll show what the scoreboard missed — and what to do next. Before they hand you a seven on the way out.
beats.caption: What the scoreboard missed — and what to do next.
